text:
maya: Quick proposal  a multi-wave PLG experiment to push high-intent trialers to activation. Wave A = short burst credits + one curated prompt pack; Wave B = credits + interactive onboarding; Wave C = credits + personalized follow-up from SDR. Measure activation at 48h.

jon: Nice. Segment = users with >=3 API calls in 24h but no saved prompts or billing. Exclude recent promo recipients.

lee: Suggested arms: control, 75 tokens + templates, 75 tokens + 60s onboarding, 75 tokens + templates + SDR-reach. Randomize at org level.

kira: Comms mix = in-console nudge, targeted email, and optional SMS if phone on file. We'll send 1 email within 4h of grant. Drafting copy now.

maya: Primary metric = activated (saved_prompt or billing) within 48h. Secondary = gen_calls and retention 7d. Sample size estimate = ~8k users to detect +4pp lift.

jon: Tracking: events must include exp_id=exp-2026-06-multiwave and arm tag. Analytics will compute lift, p-val, and cost per incremental activation.

lee: Backend: reuse /exp/grant with idempotency. If grant fails, issue fallback promo code via email. Also add per-org cap and `daily_experiment_spend_cap`.

kira: Creative: three banner variants and 2 subject lines per arm. Copy option: "Try a hand-picked prompt pack  we've added 75 tokens" vs "Get 75 tokens + a 60s guide to build a prompt that fits your data".

ops-bot: Experiment created id=exp-2026-06-multiwave, start=1775620000, end=1775820000. Logged to #growth-experiments.

sales-bot: Routing rule: if org redeems and does >10 gens within 48h, mark as warm and post webhook with source=multiwave and reason=high-activity. If SDR arm, tag follow-up required.

maya: Risk checks: block orgs with active partner promos, enterprise billed accounts, and SSO-only orgs. Also ensure compliance with promotional quotas.

jon: Cost calc: estimate redemption 55% * 75 tokens * expected token cost; we'll surface CPC and compare to CAC. If cost per incremental activation > threshold, pause.

lee: QA: verify events, idempotency, email templates, in-console mapping, and SDR playbook for arm C.

kira: I'll post email + banner mocks by EOD and open a review thread. Also propose A/B CTA text: "Claim tokens" vs "Try templates".

maya: Great. Launch target = 10 days. Check-in mid-week for blockers. Tagging @jon @lee @kira. :rocket:
